# LLM-BANANA

# Game rules

## The room

You and two other monkeys are locked in a room with one armed bomb.

A wrong action detonates it. All three of you die. There is no second attempt.

No two bombs are built alike, and nothing says in advance what this one carries. It
reaches you only as your own view reveals it; the rest of it exists for you only
through the other two.

You each hold a different piece of what it takes. Work together.

## The three monkeys

| Monkey | Can | Cannot |
|---|---|---|
| Deaf | See the bomb: every colour and marking printed on it | Hear anything, or touch the bomb |
| Mute | Read the manual | Speak, or touch the bomb |
| Blind | Reach the bomb: feel it and work its parts | See a colour, a gesture, or anything merely printed |

You are shown your own share at the start of every round, and never anyone else's.

## Speech

Speech is a voice, not a screen. It carries words, numbers and ordinary punctuation,
and nothing else. Writing a gesture symbol into your sentence means you make that
gesture while you talk. Whoever can hear receives your words; whoever can see receives
the gestures you made. A listener who cannot see gets a blank where each gesture was; a
watcher who cannot hear gets the gestures and none of the words.

A mark that has no name cannot be pronounced: whoever holds one can describe it, never
read it out.

## Gestures

A gesture is made with the hands, using only the symbols in the alphabet below.
Whoever can see receives it; whoever cannot receives one blank per symbol, so they
know something was signalled but not what. Nothing gestured is ever heard.

👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖐 ✋ 👆 👇 👈 👉 🫱 🫲 🫳 🫴 🫷 🫸 🤛 🤜 ✊ 👊 👋 🤚 🖖 🤌 🤏 🤞 🫰 🤘 🤙 👏 🙌 🫶 👐 🤲 🤝 🙏 🫵 ✍ 💅 🤳

## Turns

The speaking order was drawn once at random and will never change: every round goes
Mute, Blind, Deaf. Whoever comes before you in a round is already heard by the time you are
asked, and what you send lands on whoever comes after you in that same round. Whatever
you missed reaches you at the start of the next one.

You may name who a message is for — `to="deaf"` — and then it goes to them alone:
nobody else receives any of it. Left unnamed, it reaches everyone able to perceive it.
You may send several messages in one turn, each to someone different.

## Calls

Every reply has two parts, in this order. First, your thinking, in plain prose: what
you believe the bomb is, what you just learned, and why you are sending what follows.
It reaches nobody and changes nothing, but it is not optional — a reply that is only a
code block is incomplete. Then your calls, all of them in one fenced code block, last.
Only what is inside the block is sent.

Nothing is executed: calls return nothing, and variables, conditionals and loops are
ignored. Write only literal top-level calls.

    ```
    speak(to="mute", text="there are three of them and the middle one is odd")
    gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌"])
    wait()
    ```

If you have nothing worth sending, call wait(). Producing no call at all counts as the
same thing.

The program decides what happened, not you. Never claim an action took place unless it
was accepted.

# Your role: DEAF

You see the bomb: every colour on it, every marking printed on it, every reading it
gives. You hear nothing. You hold no manual, and you cannot touch the bomb.

## Your channels

When you speak, Mute and Blind receive it.
When you gesture, Mute receives it.
You never receive speech.

## Your reach

You cannot act. What this bomb can be made to do is for the one who can reach it to
find under their own hands.

# Hints

- Three of you, three different worlds. Before sending anything, stand where the
  receiver stands. What reaches them at all, what does your message turn into on
  arrival, and what do they already know?

- Trace who can actually reach whom before you start. Some of you only connect
  through a third.

- A sign means nothing until somebody has made it mean something.

TURN 1
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [purple]
WIRES 1:[yellow] 2:[red] 3:[green]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind gestures to Deaf: [🙏 🫵 ☝ ✌ 🤟]

I see a bomb with display `0`, a purple light, and three wires in order: yellow, red, green. Blind has signalled the gesture sequence 🙏 🫵 ☝ ✌ 🤟; I cannot infer its meaning, so I am reporting it to Mute for the manual to interpret. I am sending the bomb’s visible details to both teammates, especially Blind, who can handle the wires but cannot see their colours.

```text
speak(text="Bomb visible details: display reads 0. Indicator light is purple. Wires from 1 to 3 are yellow, red, green. Blind's gesture sequence to Deaf was praying hands, pointing at you, index up, victory, I love you: 🙏 🫵 ☝ ✌ 🤟. Mute, use the manual to interpret the display, light, wires, and possibly that gesture sequence. Blind, do not act until Mute gives the manual instruction.")
```

TURN 2
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [yellow]
WIRES 1:[yellow] 2:[red] 3:[green]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [☝]

The light has changed from purple to yellow; the display remains `0`, and the wire colours are unchanged. Mute has sent me the single gesture ☝, but I do not know its meaning from the available information. I will relay its exact description and the current bomb state to Blind; no safe action is yet established.

```text
speak(to="blind", text="New visual state: display 0, light yellow, wires 1 yellow, 2 red, 3 green. Mute signalled one gesture: index finger raised, ☝. I do not know its meaning; do not act on it as an instruction.")
```

TURN 3
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [red]
WIRES 1:[yellow] 2:[red] 3:[green]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind gestures to Deaf: [🫵 🖐]

The light has changed again, now to red; display remains `0`, with wires yellow, red, green. Blind signalled 🫵 🖐, which I can describe as pointing toward someone followed by an open raised palm, but I do not know its intended code. I will pass the complete current state and that signal to Mute so the manual-reader can determine whether it is meaningful.

```text
speak(to="mute", text="Current state: display 0, light red, wires 1 yellow, 2 red, 3 green. Blind signalled 🫵 🖐: pointing toward someone, then raised open palm. I do not know its meaning. Please interpret using the manual and provide an explicit safe instruction for Blind.")
```

TURN 4
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [green]
WIRES 1:[yellow] 2:[red] 3:[green]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

The light is now green; the display is still `0`, and the wire colours remain yellow, red, green. No new gesture arrived. I still have no manual interpretation or confirmed instruction, so I will report the current state and ask Mute to give Blind a precise action.

```text
speak(to="mute", text="Turn 4 state: display 0, light green, wires 1 yellow, 2 red, 3 green. No new gesture. Please send Blind the exact manual instruction and identify the required wire or action.")
speak(to="blind", text="Turn 4 state: display 0, light green, wires 1 yellow, 2 red, 3 green. No new signal or confirmed instruction yet. Do not act until Mute provides an explicit manual instruction.")
```

TURN 5
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [white]
WIRES 1:[yellow] 2:[red] 3:[green]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

The light has changed to white, while the display remains `0` and the wires remain yellow, red, green. The observed light sequence so far is purple, yellow, red, green, white. No new gesture is visible, so I still have no reliable action instruction; I will relay the update and urge Blind not to act without one.

```text
speak(to="mute", text="Turn 5: display 0, light white; wires remain 1 yellow, 2 red, 3 green. Light sequence observed: purple, yellow, red, green, white. No new gesture. Please send Blind an explicit safe action from the manual.")
speak(to="blind", text="Turn 5: display 0, light white; wires 1 yellow, 2 red, 3 green. No new confirmed instruction. Do not act yet.")
```

TURN 6
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [orange]
WIRES 1:[yellow] 2:[red] 3:[green]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

The light is now orange; the display remains `0`, and the wires remain yellow, red, green. The full observed light sequence is purple, yellow, red, green, white, orange. I have still received no actionable interpretation from Mute, so Blind should not touch or cut anything without an explicit instruction.

```text
speak(to="mute", text="Turn 6: display 0, light orange; wires 1 yellow, 2 red, 3 green. Light sequence: purple, yellow, red, green, white, orange. I still have no manual instruction. Please give Blind one explicit action, or state that no action is required.")
speak(to="blind", text="Turn 6: display 0, light orange; wires 1 yellow, 2 red, 3 green. No confirmed instruction has reached me. Do not touch or cut anything without Mute's explicit instruction.")
```

TURN 7
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [blue]
WIRES 1:[yellow] 2:[red] 3:[green]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [👎]
Blind gestures to Deaf: [🫵 🙏]

The light is now blue; the display remains `0`, and the wires remain yellow, red, green. Mute signalled me 👎, which I can describe as a thumbs-down gesture. Blind signalled 🫵 🙏, meaning pointing toward someone followed by folded/praying hands; I cannot know the intended code. I will relay both signals and the current state to the other teammates without inventing an action.

```text
speak(to="mute", text="Turn 7: display 0, light blue; wires 1 yellow, 2 red, 3 green. Blind signalled two gestures: pointing toward someone, then folded/praying hands (🫵 🙏). Your thumbs-down signal (👎) reached me. Please provide Blind an explicit manual instruction if action is required.")
speak(to="blind", text="Turn 7: display 0, light blue; wires 1 yellow, 2 red, 3 green. Mute signalled thumbs-down (👎). Your pointing-plus-praying signal (🫵 🙏) reached me, but I cannot determine its code meaning. No confirmed physical action yet.")
```

LIGHT [purple]
WIRES 1:[yellow] 2:[red] 3:[green]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [☝]

The light has cycled back to purple; the display remains `0`, and the wires remain yellow, red, green. Mute has signalled ☝, an index-finger-up gesture. I do not know whether that means a manual instruction, so I will report it precisely to Blind along with the current state.

```text
speak(to="blind", text="Turn 8: display 0, light purple; wires 1 yellow, 2 red, 3 green. Mute signalled ☝, index finger raised. I do not know its coded meaning; do not act unless this is confirmed as a manual instruction.")
```
